summary.headline: Mercury in the Planetary Houses
summary.text: Astrological delineations of planetary placements in the houses of Mars, the Sun, the native planet, Mercury, and the Moon, including effects on marriage, enemies, pleasures, occupations, and reputation. Chapter VI begins the significations of Mercury, describing Mercury in the houses of Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars.
